additional_info.subject: RE: ID0440823-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / R4 170001723] cooling cable error CRM:00798002334
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Following Daniel's investigation of the charger today, we concluded that the cable needs to be replaced due to a defective CAN communication. To ensure the CAN receiver on the KF11 is not faulty, we also replaced the EcogController with a new one and the issue remained.
I remain at your disposal if you need any further assistance.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL

o not change the subject of this email when replying to it.
